source_description: Where exactly this receipt came from (e.g. 'employee X's expense report ER-12345, page 7, supplied by Finance on 2026-11-02')
owner: Who owns / controls the receipt (company, employee, public-domain holder)
permission_basis: Why it may be used here: company-authorised internal evaluation | CC0 | CC-BY (attribution given) | licence agreement | written permission from the holder
authorized_by: Name and role of the person who authorised its use for this evaluation
licence_or_terms_reference: URL or document reference, if any
brand_family: Nayara | Jio-bp | Shell | IndianOil | BPCL | HPCL | independent | other
receipt_family: A short layout id fixed NOW, e.g. nayara_pos_thermal_A (all receipts printed by the same template share it)
personal_data_handling: What personal / payment data the image contains and what was redacted (card numbers, names, vehicle numbers) or 'none present'
